resources.string: Ebb uses this service to notice when you open an app you chose to limit, so it can ask how long you want to use it, show when it unlocks, and end your session on time. It does not collect or send any text or personal data.
Turning this on stops Ebb from being uninstalled on impulse. Ebb asks for no device admin powers: it cannot lock, wipe or watch your phone. You can turn it off later from inside Ebb.
Ebb protection is on. Turn it off from inside Ebb instead.
